name: ai_content_studio_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the ai_content_studio capability.

prompts.name: script_generation_prompt
prompts.template: Write a detailed, engaging script about {topic} in a {tone} tone of approximately {length} words.
prompts.use_case: YouTube channel creators looking to automate and scale content production

prompts.name: voiceover_customization_prompt
prompts.template: Generate a voiceover for the following script using a {voice_type} voice with {language} language and {speed} speed: {script_text}
prompts.use_case: Marketers producing automated video ads or explainer videos

prompts.name: upload_video_prompt
prompts.template: Upload the video titled '{video_title}' with description '{video_description}' to the connected YouTube channel.
prompts.use_case: Educational content developers generating course videos automatically
